query: Find 10 buildings in Stavanger municipality that are located on agricultural land and within soil- and flood-landslide hazard areas, sorted by bygningid ascending.

5.description: Intersect buildings (step 1) with AR50 agricultural polygons (step 3)

7.description: (Optional) ensure final geometry present for sorting/limiting

8.description: Sort final results by bygningid ascending and limit to 10

args.sql:
SELECT kommunenummer, ST_XMin(envelope) AS xmin, ST_YMin(envelope) AS ymin, ST_XMax(envelope) AS xmax, ST_YMax(envelope) AS ymax
FROM (
  SELECT kommunenummer, ST_Envelope(ST_Union(omrade)) AS envelope
  FROM kommuner_627ee106072240e99d2b21ec4717bf01.kommune
  WHERE kommunenavn ILIKE 'Stavanger'
  GROUP BY kommunenummer
) t;
